result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers find the same core problems: too many families, Lobster as body text at 13px with tight leading, hairline weights, the @import chain, unused weights, display=block and missing fallbacks. B goes further. It counts the font files (about 15) and gives a two-family replacement, Nunito with Fredoka for headings and buttons, which keeps more of the kid-friendly personality. B's 'URL has a bug' item is mislabeled because it then says the syntax is fine, while A is tighter but its single-family Nunito setup is a bit plainer. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers diagnose the font setup well: too many families, Lobster as the body face at 13px with tight leading, hairline weights, the @import chain, display=block and missing fallbacks. A's replacement keeps more of the playful character a children's practice needs by pairing Fredoka headings and buttons with Nunito body text. B's single-family Nunito setup is clean and self-hosted but a bit plainer, and it pushes personality to an optional logo face. A has one confusing point: it labels the Comic Neue URL a 'bug' and then says it is fine.
